title: Readability: clearer names in is_followed
bug: `GET /me/following/<id>` answers whether they follow you, not you them.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR renamed variables but also inverted the logic in `is_followed` from `user.is_following(followed_user)` to `other.is_following(me)`, changing who is checked as the follower and causing 404 to become 204 for alice_follow, bob_follow_alice, carol_unfollow.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR renamed variables but also inverted the logic in `is_followed` from `user.is_following(followed_user)` to `other.is_following(me)`, changing who is checked as the follower and causing 404 to become 204 for alice_follow, bob_follow_alice, carol_unfollow.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR renamed variables but also inverted the logic in `is_followed` from `user.is_following(followed_user)` to `other.is_following(me)`, changing who is checked as the follower and causing 404 to become 204 for alice_follow, bob_follow_alice, carol_unfollow.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The same logic inversion causes dave_follow_all to receive 404 instead of 204 because the check now asks if the target user follows the current user instead of the reverse.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The same logic inversion causes dave_follow_all to receive 404 instead of 204 because the check now asks if the target user follows the current user instead of the reverse.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The same logic inversion causes dave_follow_all to receive 404 instead of 204 because the check now asks if the target user follows the current user instead of the reverse.

doppel.summary: The PR inadvertently reversed the follow-check logic while renaming variables, turning intended 404s into 204s and vice versa for multiple personas.

personas.goal: Follow carol and verify the is_followed endpoint returns 204

personas.goal: Follow alice and check is_followed with reversed direction

review.why: The PR inverts the follow-check logic: it now returns 404 when the target user does NOT follow the current user, whereas the original correctly returned 404 when the current user does NOT follow the target. This changes the API's behavior for the /api/users/me/followed/<id> endpoint.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The diff shows the logic was inverted from `user.is_following(followed_user)` to `other.is_following(me)`, which reverses the follow relationship check and causes the 404 to become a 204 for the test persona.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The diff shows the logic was inverted from `user.is_following(followed_user)` to `other.is_following(me)`, which reverses the follow relationship check and causes the 404 to become a 204 for the test persona.

doppel_guided.summary: The variable rename introduced a logic inversion that changed the follow-check direction, turning a 404 into a 204.
